steps.text: The practice marks confirm that the brush is inked and that pressure controls width: about 3 mm at a shallow press and about 18 mm at a deep press. I’m mapping each point on the planned centerlines to the exemplar’s local stroke width, so the long roof and crossbar stay thin while the heavier turns spread more.

+"""RoboPaint trajectory for the live rcb-limited/2.0 episode.

+The ink dip and two unscored practice strokes were already executed at the

+        "name": "lower_crossbar",
+        "cap_mm": 11.0,
+        "points": [(263, 582), (287, 591), (310, 592), (340, 589), (375, 582), (414, 575), (454, 570), (495, 565), (537, 561), (581, 557), (627, 554), (672, 552), (710, 552), (740, 557), (765, 565), (777, 570)],
+    },
+]
+
+
+def pixel_to_world(uv: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Convert target image (u,v) to the main sheet's world x,y."""
+    u, v = uv[..., 0], uv[..., 1]
+    x = -0.100 + 0.1135925 - (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
+    y = 0.1135925 - (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
+    return np.stack([x, y], axis=-1)
+
+
+def smooth_pixel_route(waypoints: list[tuple[float, float]]) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Densify and lightly smooth hand-traced centerline waypoints."""
+    dense = []
+    for a, b in zip(waypoints[:-1], waypoints[1:]):
+        a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
+        b = np.asarray(b, dtype=float)
+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b - a) * 2.0)))
+        ts = np.arange(n, dtype=float) / n
+        dense.extend(a[None, :] * (1 - ts[:, None]) + b[None, :] * ts[:, None])
+    dense.append(np.asarray(waypoints[-1], dtype=float))
+    dense = np.asarray(dense)
+    if len(dense) >= 9:
+        dense = np.stack(
+            [gaussian_filter1d(dense[:, k], sigma=1.4, mode="nearest") for k in range(2)],
+            axis=1,
+        )
+    return dense
+
+
+def make_route(stroke: dict, distance_px: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    """Return arc-length-sampled world xyz targets for one contact stroke."""
+    uv_dense = smooth_pixel_route(stroke["points"])
+    xy_dense = pixel_to_world(uv_dense)
+    ds = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xy_dense, axis=0), axis=1)
+    arc = np.concatenate([[0.0], np.cumsum(ds)])
+    step_m = 0.0020
+    sample_arc = np.arange(0.0, arc[-1], step_m)
+    if not len(sample_arc) or sample_arc[-1] < arc[-1]:
+        sample_arc = np.append(sample_arc, arc[-1])
+    xy = np.stack([np.interp(sample_arc, arc, xy_dense[:, k]) for k in range(2)], axis=1)
+    uv = np.stack([np.interp(sample_arc, arc, uv_dense[:, k]) for k in range(2)], axis=1)
+
+    # Match the local diameter of the exemplar's ink.  Practice calibration:
+    # z=.017 m gave ~3 mm width; z=.005 m gave ~17.5 mm.
+    radius_px = map_coordinates(distance_px, [uv[:, 1], uv[:, 0]], order=1, mode="nearest")
+    width_mm = np.minimum(2.0 * radius_px * MM_PER_PX, stroke["cap_mm"])
+    width_mm = gaussian_filter1d(width_mm, sigma=1.2, mode="nearest")
+    press_mm = np.clip((width_mm + 0.62) / 1.208, 2.0, 15.0)
+    z = SHEET_Z - press_mm / 1000.0
+    xyz = np.column_stack([xy, z]).astype(np.float32)
+    return xyz, uv
+
+
+def interpolate_segment(a: np.ndarray, b: np.ndarray, spacing: float) -> list[np.ndarray]:
+    d = float(np.linalg.norm(b[:3] - a[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(d / spacing)))
+    return [a * (1.0 - t) + b * t for t in np.linspace(1.0 / n, 1.0, n)]
+
+
+def pose_rows(points: list[np.ndarray], q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.asarray([np.r_[p[:3], q] for p in points], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def submit_rows(robot: Robot, rows: np.ndarray, note: str, out: pathlib.Path | None = None):
+    if len(rows) * 0.1 > 9.95:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"chunk too long ({len(rows)} rows)")
+    res = robot.submit(
+        "ee_pose", rows, dt=0.1, video="both",
+        cameras=("canvas_cam", "side_cam"), video_fps=5, note=note,
+    )
+    fails = sum(int(p.get("ik_failures", 0)) for p in res.meta.get("plan", []))
+    if out is not None:
+        res.save(str(out))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "note": note,
+        "rows": len(rows),
+        "sim_time_s": res.meta.get("sim_time_s"),
+        "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "ik_failures": fails,
+        "tip": res.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])[7:10],
+    }))
+    return res
+
+
+def approach(robot: Robot, xyz_goal: np.ndarray, q: np.ndarray, out: pathlib.Path):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=("side_cam",), video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    cur = now[7:10]
+    q_live = now[10:14]
+    # Keep the handle clear while moving above the sheet.
+    safe_z = max(float(cur[2]), 0.12)
+    pts: list[np.ndarray] = []
+    if cur[2] < safe_z - 0.001:
+        a = np.r_[cur, 0.0]
+        b = np.array([cur[0], cur[1], safe_z, 0.0])
+        pts += interpolate_segment(a, b, 0.006)
+        pts += [b] * 8
+        cur = b[:3]
+    a = np.r_[cur, 0.0]
+    b = np.array([xyz_goal[0], xyz_goal[1], safe_z, 0.0])
+    pts += interpolate_segment(a, b, 0.008)
+    pts += [b] * 12
+    # Normalize to the observed vertical brush quaternion.
+    rows = pose_rows(pts, q_live)
+    res = submit_rows(robot, rows, f"approach {out.name}", out)
+
+    actual = np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"][7:10], dtype=float)
+    miss = np.linalg.norm(actual[:2] - xyz_goal[:2])
+    if miss > 0.004 or actual[2] < 0.065:
+        fix_a = np.r_[actual, 0.0]
+        fix_b = np.array([xyz_goal[0], xyz_goal[1], max(safe_z, 0.09), 0.0])
+        fix = interpolate_segment(fix_a, fix_b, 0.003) + [fix_b] * 12
+        submit_rows(robot, pose_rows(fix, q_live), f"settle over {out.name}", out / "settle")
+
+
+def execute_stroke(robot: Robot, i: int, stroke: dict, xyz: np.ndarray, q: np.ndarray):
+    dest = RUNS / f"{i + 1:02d}_{stroke['name']}"
+    dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    start = xyz[0]
+    approach(robot, start, q, dest / "approach")
+
+    # Lower slowly at the first point. The brush is already ink-loaded.
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=("side_cam",), video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    cur = now[7:10]
+    q_live = now[10:14]
+    lower_start = np.r_[cur, 0.0]
+    lower_end = np.r_[start, 0.0]
+    lower = interpolate_segment(lower_start, lower_end, 0.0025) + [lower_end] * 3
+    submit_rows(robot, pose_rows(lower, q_live), f"lower {stroke['name']}", dest / "lower")
+
+    # Follow the pressure-aware centerline at about 20 mm/s.
+    trace = pose_rows(list(xyz), q_live)
+    submit_rows(robot, trace, f"main stroke {i + 1}: {stroke['name']}", dest / "trace")
+
+    # Lift vertically before any between-stroke travel, ending the contact.
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=("side_cam",), video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    cur = now[7:10]
+    lift_end = np.array([cur[0], cur[1], TRAVEL_Z], dtype=float)
+    lift = interpolate_segment(np.r_[cur, 0.0], np.r_[lift_end, 0.0], 0.004)
+    lift += [np.r_[lift_end, 0.0]] * 8
+    submit_rows(robot, pose_rows(lift, now[10:14]), f"lift after {stroke['name']}", dest / "lift")
+
+
+def retreat_and_observe(robot: Robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=("side_cam",), video="none")
+    now = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    p = now[7:10]
+    q = now[10:14]
+    high = max(float(p[2]), 0.14)
+    pts: list[np.ndarray] = []
+    up = np.array([p[0], p[1], high, 0.0])
+    pts += interpolate_segment(np.r_[p, 0.0], up, 0.004)
+    dest = np.array([0.07, -0.25, 0.16, 0.0])
+    pts += interpolate_segment(up, dest, 0.008)
+    pts += [dest] * 15
+    submit_rows(robot, pose_rows(pts, q), "retreat for final camera check", RUNS / "retreat")
+    final = robot.get_obs(cameras=("canvas_cam", "side_cam"), video="none")
+    final.save(str(RUNS / "final_observation"))
+    print("final time_left_s", final.meta.get("time_left_s"))
+
+
+def save_centerline_preview(routes: list[np.ndarray], out_path: pathlib.Path):
+    image = Image.open(TARGET).convert("RGB")
+    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(image)
+    colors = [(230, 30, 40), (25, 120, 240), (15, 170, 90), (220, 130, 20), (150, 55, 210), (20, 170, 190)]
+    for i, route in enumerate(routes):
+        uv = route[:, :2]
+        pts = [tuple(np.round(p).astype(int)) for p in uv]
+        draw.line(pts, fill=colors[i], width=2)
+        draw.ellipse((pts[0][0] - 3, pts[0][1] - 3, pts[0][0] + 3, pts[0][1] + 3), fill=colors[i])
+    image.save(out_path)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--start", type=int, default=0, help="first stroke index, zero based")
+    parser.add_argument("--end", type=int, default=6, help="exclusive last stroke index")
+    parser.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true", help="save centerline overlay without connecting")
+    parser.add_argument("--no-retreat", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    rgb = np.asarray(Image.open(TARGET).convert("RGB"))
+    mask = rgb.mean(axis=2) < 128
+    distance_px = distance_transform_edt(mask)
